about_the_game:
Backrooms: Final Exam Part II is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Together or alone, you'll return to a place you were never meant to leave. The deeper you go, the more uncertain it becomes whether there was ever a way out.

Even more complicated!

Features

- Scary atmosphere!

- 1 to 4 player co-op

- Proximity voice chat

- Immersive AI

- Game Difficulties

- Stealth

- Large & difficult map

- Primitive but challenging gameplay

Important Notes

This is not a typical Backrooms game. It doesn’t follow every detail from the online community. Instead, it offers a unique interpretation, integrating select elements in a fresh and atmospheric way.

The game includes flickering lights and audiovisual effects that may affect sensitive players.

Built using the SNK V2 system — featuring an improved main menu, enhanced lobby, online server browser, difficulty selection, player sound system (with UI feedback and AI reaction), and a dynamic visibility system based on movement, posture, and flashlight use.
